text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
See? You can run well even if you're<n>not part of
some famous family. And<n>Dober's a part of my
family now!<n>Dual affiliation is totally okay with me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm running in the Oka Sho next! Time<n>to recruit
more members for the Pearl<n>family!
